title: FreeRTOS-Style Ready Scheduler
shortDescription: Implement a tiny priority scheduler with ready bits and tick-based delays.

templates.notes: Model task state explicitly; the harness exercises tick and ready transitions.

visibleCases.name: highest priority wins
visibleCases.displayInput: tasks: id1 prio1, id2 prio3, id3 prio2

visibleCases.name: tie breaks by task id
visibleCases.displayInput: two ready tasks at same priority

visibleCases.name: delay blocks task
visibleCases.displayInput: delay highest priority task by 2 ticks
visibleCases.displayExpect: lower priority runs until delay expires

hiddenCases.name: multiple delays expire
hiddenCases.displayInput: two delayed tasks with different delays
hiddenCases.displayExpect: highest unblocked priority selected each tick
hiddenCases.explanation: Tick handling must update all blocked tasks.
